dedupe_keys.name: jcpra municipal recycling data japan container and packaging waste taken from each municipality by material and month storage facility counts fees and sales of recycled products

description: These data show how much separately collected container and packaging waste, such as glass bottles, PET bottles and plastic packaging, each Japanese municipality hands over for recycling. They are published by the Japan Containers and Packaging Recycling Association (JCPRA), which takes over this waste from municipalities. A single workbook gives, by fiscal year, material and month, the tonnes taken over and the tonnes contracted, the number of municipalities and storage facilities served, the fees paid by municipalities, and the sales of recycled products by use; coverage is national, and one sheet lists contract and actual tonnes for every municipality or waste union, with about 79,000 rows. Plastic product waste collected together with packaging has been included since FY2023. The workbook is free and available to download as Excel, with interactive Tableau views and zipped CSV lists of obliged businesses by prefecture. Caveats: headers are in Japanese, the current fiscal year is partial, only packaging handed to JCPRA is counted, and no licence is named. Simulation uses: modelling recyclable flows from municipal storage sites to recyclers, estimating how a disaster that closes storage facilities would affect collection, and setting per-municipality baselines. Related records: the Japanese municipal waste treatment survey (data-japan-municipal-waste-treatment-survey), the Portuguese Sociedade Ponto Verde collection data (data-sociedade-ponto-verde-packaging-collection) and the Finnish packaging volumes (data-finland-packaging-volumes-epr).
